news.body:
## Your last fortnight at Locus starts today
- Your last working day is 6 December, thirteen days out.
Two things on the board run through Locus people: the KITAS cancellation, which is sitting on a payment Jishnu has not released, and your x360 observers, who are mostly colleagues. Both get harder once you are off the payroll.
- Club 8 has not written back since Wednesday.
You asked Marie about the room and the keys on the 19th and nothing has come back. - Chase it at the end of the week if it is still quiet.
## Harver is the one thing nobody outside is pushing
- Kraft Heinz, a week past its date and still not opened.
Two nudges and no movement usually means the task is wrong rather than you are. - Tell me to drop it and I will, otherwise it wants an evening this week.
